claim: MUSINF holds ~1,700 works from 50+ artists and a complete anthology of 250 photos donated by Mario Giacomelli, including the Scanno and 'Io non ho mani' series, plus the Misa Photographic School founded by Giuseppe Cavalli in 1950s Senigallia.
quote: approximately 1,700 works donated by over 50 major artists ... a complete anthology of two hundred fifty photos ... Misa Photographic School, established in Senigallia during the 1950s, with particular emphasis on founder Giuseppe Cavalli and Giacomelli

claim: The original MUSINF location is closed for renovation; its collections have been transferred to Palazzo del Duca, with admission free.
quote: Currently closed for renovations. Collections have been transferred to Palazzo del Duca. Admission is free.

claim: Palazzo del Duca shows a permanent Mario Giacomelli collection plus rotating photography exhibitions; in summer 2026 Palazzo del Duca and Palazzetto Baviera open Thu-Sun with evening hours, and a Rocca Roveresca ticket earns a discount on the civic museums.
quote: Palazzo del Duca houses a permanent collection of works by Mario Giacomelli ... An entrance ticket to Rocca Roveresca allows a discount on admission to the civic museums Palazzo del Duca and Palazzetto Baviera

claim: Palazzetto Baviera full-price admission is EUR 4 with concessions; tickets are sold at Palazzo del Duca and online via liveticket.it.
quote: Full price admission to Palazzetto Baviera is €4 with discounts and concessions available.

claim: Palazzo Mastai is the 16th-century birthplace of Pope Pius IX (born 13 May 1792); the first-floor Museo Pio IX holds relics of his life including a cycle of twenty biblical canvases by Giovanni Anastasi, and entry is free.
quote: the birthplace of Pope Pius IX (Giovanni Maria Mastai Ferretti) on May 13, 1792 ... a cycle of twenty canvases with biblical subjects ... Free entry

claim: The Pinacoteca Diocesana, in the bishop's palace on Piazza Garibaldi (opened 1992), centers on Federico Barocci's 'Madonna of the Rosary and Saint Dominic' (1588-1592) plus works by Andrea Lilli, Donducci and Ramazzani; entry is free.
quote: The collection's most celebrated piece is The Madonna of the Rosary and Saint Dominic by Federico Barocci (1535-1612) ... Admission: Free entry

claim: The Area Archeologica e Museo 'La Fenice' was closed to the public until 1 March 2026 for restoration coordinated by the Superintendence of Archaeology.
quote: The Archaeological Area and Museum La Fenice will remain closed to the public until March 1, 2026 for maintenance and restoration work

claim: La Fenice is a museumized excavation beneath the modern theatre showing Roman buildings (2nd-3rd c. AD) at the cardo/decumanus crossing of ancient Sena, walkable a few metres below ground.
quote: one of the few places in Italy where it's possible to admire both the remains of Roman buildings together with finds recovered on site ... the intersection between a 'cardo' ... and a 'decumanus'

claim: The Rocca Roveresca (Della Rovere Fortress, state-run) opens daily 8:30-19:30; admission is EUR 5 full, EUR 2 reduced (18-25), free under 18 and on the first Sunday of the month.
quote: From Monday to Sunday 8.30 a.m. – 7.30 p.m. ... Standard admission: € 5.00 ... Free entry for children under 18 and on the first Sunday of each month

claim: Typical museum-weekend hours: Casa Museo Pio IX Thu 9-14 and Sat 15-20 (free); Pinacoteca Diocesana daily 9-12 and 16-21; Palazzo del Duca and Palazzetto Baviera Thu-Sun with paid entry.
quote: Casa Museo Pio IX: 'giovedì dalle 9.00 alle 14.00 e sabato dalle 15.00 alle 20.00' ... Pinacoteca Diocesana: 'tutti i giorni dalle 9.00 alle 12.00 e dalle 16.00 alle 21.00'
